verses.html: 9 Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.

verses.html: 10 She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.

verses.html: 9 [When Jesus lived again early on Sunday morning, Mary from the town of Magdala was the first person to see him. Jesus had forced seven demons out of her.

verses.html: 10 She approached Jesus’ apprentices, who were grieving very much. She told them {what she had seen}.

verses.html: 11 So, the apprentices learned that Jesus was alive and that Mary had seen him. However, they did not accept what she said.

verses.html: 12 Sometime later, two of Jesus’ apprentices were traveling to farm areas. They saw Jesus, although he looked different.

verses.html: 13 Then, the two apprentices went back {to Jerusalem}. They told the other apprentices what had happened, but the others did not accept what the two apprentices said.

verses.html: 14 Sometime later, Jesus revealed himself to his 11 representatives while they were eating. Because they had not accepted it when people told them that they had seen Jesus after God made him alive again, Jesus scolded them. He told them that they should not have stubbornly refused to accept what those people said.

verses.html: 16 God will rescue all people who trust in me and who have someone baptize them. However, God will punish all people who do not trust in me.

verses.html: 17 I will enable those who trust in me to perform miracles. Specifically, they will represent me by forcing demons out {of people}. They will talk in languages that they have not learned.

verses.html: 19 After the Lord Jesus said that to his apprentices, God brought him up into heaven. There, Jesus sat down to rule with God {the Father}.
